name: Onyx Private
long_description: Onyx is a modern, accessible private bank for the next generation of affluent young professionals. We offer a unified digital-native premium banking and wealth management experience tailored for the overlooked groups of young high-earners and illiquid entrepreneurs, investors, and tech employees. Onyx aims to be the next-generation UBS.
one_liner: A modern and more accessible private bank for the new generation

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Serial technology founder, product executive & operator with two exits. Founded banQi, a neobank that brought affordable banking, digital payments, and ML credit underwriting to over 3M low-income Brazilian families, processing R$10B TPV/year, before being acquired by Casas Bahia, one of Brazil's largest retailers. Also founded Onyx Private (YC W22), an accessible digital private bank with AI concierge & $100M of TPV/year before being acquired by Citizens Bank. UC Berkeley graduate, Wharton MBA.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Doug spent time at Monitor Group, Bain & Co and large multinational companies in Brazil. Most recently, he helped grow Airfox / banQi to millions of users and assisted with the company’s acquisition. He is a MBA grad from MIT Sloan and Mechanical Engineer from USP in Brazil.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Prior to Onyx, Tiago was the Principal Architect of Airfox / banQi, helping to implement a highly scalable banking platform. He has over 20 years of experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer, working for big companies in the US and Latin America.

news.title: Onyx Private believes affluent professionals need their own bank, so it’s building one | TechCrunch
